intent: Compare the Human Development Index trajectories of North Korea, Thailand, Portugal, India, and DR Congo from the early twentieth century through the final year shown.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
Does the video compare the HDI trajectories of North Korea, Thailand, Portugal, India, and DR Congo from the early twentieth century through the final year shown?
Thailand's HDI rises from 0.0501 in 1900 to 0.5201 at the final point, an overall upward trajectory.
Portugal's HDI rises from 0.0601 in 1900 to 0.48 at the final point, an overall upward trajectory.
India's HDI rises from 0.0401 in 1900 to 0.3999 at the final point, and DR Congo's HDI rises from 0.0799 in 1950 to 0.3501 at its final point; both show overall upward trajectories.

units.claim: All 5 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: North Korea's HDI rises from 0.0501 in 1900 to 0.94 at the final point, an overall upward trajectory.
units.computation: Compare first value (0.0501) and last value (0.94); last > first indicates upward trend.
accept: North Korea's HDI increases from 0.0501 to 0.94
North Korea shows an upward HDI trajectory

units.claim: Thailand's HDI rises from 0.0501 in 1900 to 0.5201 at the final point, an overall upward trajectory.
units.computation: Compare first value (0.0501) and last value (0.5201); last > first indicates upward trend.
accept: Thailand shows an upward HDI trajectory

units.claim: Portugal's HDI rises from 0.0601 in 1900 to 0.48 at the final point, an overall upward trajectory.
units.computation: Compare first value (0.0601) and last value (0.48); last > first indicates upward trend.
accept: Portugal shows an upward HDI trajectory

units.claim: India's HDI rises from 0.0401 in 1900 to 0.3999 at the final point, and DR Congo's HDI rises from 0.0799 in 1950 to 0.3501 at its final point; both show overall upward trajectories.
units.computation: For India, compare first (0.0401) and last (0.3999); for DR Congo, compare first (0.0799) and last (0.3501); both last > first indicate upward trends.
accept: DR Congo's HDI increases from 0.0799 to 0.3501
Both India and DR Congo show upward HDI trajectories
reject: Either India or DR Congo remains flat

optional_valid: North Korea ends with the highest HDI among the five countries shown.
DR Congo starts later (1950) than the other four series (1900).
unsupported_to_avoid: Exact year-by-year values for points without explicit x labels.
review_notes: The intent asks to compare trajectories across five entities; each entity's trend is captured as a separate unit, with India and DR Congo combined because both are shorter series and the intent does not require separate per-entity granularity beyond the trend claim.
Only first and last points are used as minimal evidence for each trend; intermediate points are not required.
